zoom_new_meeting_trigger.description: Runs when a new meeting is scheduled in Zoom.

output.trigger_event: The meeting, as an object with the fields id, topic, start_time (when it starts, ISO 8601), duration_minutes (how long it is scheduled for, in minutes), timezone and join_url (the link guests open to join)

parameters.description: The Zoom host whose meetings to watch. Use their Zoom login email, or leave blank to watch the account that owns the connection.
parameters.name: user_id

zoom_webinar_ended_trigger.description: Beta. Runs once each time one of your Zoom webinars finishes, with the webinar's ID ready for 'List webinar registrants' and the link to its cloud recording. To send people the recording, set 'Wait for the recording' to yes: Zoom takes a while to process a recording, and the run then starts when it is ready to watch. Webinars that ended before the workflow was turned on don't start it. Needs Zoom's Webinars add-on. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.end_time: When the webinar ended, as ISO 8601 in UTC, such as 2026-11-30T18:02:11Z: the end of its recording, or without one the moment it was found to be over, a few minutes late at most.
output.has_recording: true when recording_link is filled in, false when the webinar has no cloud recording (yet).
output.id: The webinar's ID, a number as text such as 12345678901, for 'List webinar registrants'.
output.join_url: The link people opened to join the webinar.
output.recording_link: The link to share so people can watch the cloud recording, with its passcode built in when Zoom gives one. Empty when Zoom has no recording of the webinar (yet).
output.recording_passcode: The recording's passcode, for a viewer who is asked for it. Empty when there is none.
output.start_time: When the webinar really started, as ISO 8601 in UTC, such as 2026-11-30T17:00:00Z.
output.uuid: Zoom's ID for this one session of the webinar; a webinar that repeats has a new one each time.

parameters.description: Beta. Enter yes to start the run when the webinar's cloud recording is ready to watch, which Zoom usually takes an hour or two over, so recording_link is filled in. A webinar that still has no recording 30 hours after it started runs anyway, with recording_link empty and has_recording false. Leave empty to run as soon as the webinar ends, when the recording is usually not ready.
parameters.name: wait_for_recording

parameters.description: Beta. Only run for this webinar: its webinar ID, the number Zoom shows for it, such as 123 4567 8901. Leave empty to run for every webinar the host runs.
parameters.name: webinar_id

parameters.description: Beta. The Zoom user whose webinars to watch: their Zoom login email. Leave empty to watch the account that connected Zoom. Another user works only if the Zoom app was set up by an admin for the whole account.
parameters.name: user_id
